verdict.rationale: Jules is explicitly a cloud-hosted agent that runs in Google-managed VMs, clones repos, executes tasks, and returns PRs — no self-hosted backend required (jules-docs-1, jules-docs-3, jules-docs-8). This is corroborated by community usage describing it as a fully cloud-based experience run from phone/browser with no local infra (jules-comm-1, jules-comm-12, jules-comm-16), plus a documented API/usage-limits system confirming it's a managed multi-tenant service (jules-docs-9, jules-docs-13). Missing for 10: independent infra/architecture disclosure (e.g., SLA, scaling internals) and no dispute in evidence about backend requirements.
